description: Approve a spender contract to transfer ERC-20 tokens on your behalf. Required before interacting with any DeFi protocol (DEXs, lending, etc.). Specify an exact amount. "max" (an unlimited allowance) is refused by default and always under a spend policy; only the operator can allow it, with AGENTWALLET_ALLOW_UNLIMITED_APPROVAL=1 while no policy is set. Under a spend policy an approval is a spend: it counts against the budgets and the spender is checked as a recipient.

amount.description: Amount to approve in human-readable format (e.g. "1000"); "max" means unlimited and is refused unless the operator allowed it

decimals.description: Token decimals. Resolved from the registry or the token contract when omitted; if given, it must match

spender.description: Contract address to approve as spender

name: approve_token
